pattern: SELECT \* FROM ( SELECT .+ AS subquery1 ) ON .+ JOIN ( SELECT .+ AS subquery2 ) ON .+ WHERE ( SELECT MAX(.+) FROM ( SELECT .+ AS subquery3) AS MaxSubquery )
correction: Directly join the main tables, group by the relevant column, count the number of records, sort in descending order, and limit the result set to the top 1 record.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that unnecessarily use multiple subqueries when a direct join between the main tables would suffice.
